newsitem.title: CHINA: Pudong foreign trade up 28 percent Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: Pudong foreign trade up 28 percent Jan-May.

text.p: Foreign trade volume from Shanghai's Pudong development zone jumped 28 percent in the January-May period on a year-on-year basis to $3.266 billion, the Xinhua news agency reported on Monday.

The agency said customs figures showed Pudong's trade is dominated by machinery and electronic products, with imports of such items up 49 percent to $589 million, and exports up 80 percent to $517 million during the five-month period.
Japan was the zone's top foreign trade partner with the United States in second place and Hong Kong third.
